name: magpie
body:
## Features
- Antigravity now supports project hooks and subagents defined in `.agents/hooks.json`.

### Install

Download from [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai), or `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`. An installed magpie updates itself.

- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `magpie-darwin-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS (Intel):** `magpie-darwin-amd64.dmg`
- **Windows:** `magpie-windows-amd64.exe` (ARM: `magpie-windows-arm64.exe`)
- **Linux:** `magpie-linux-amd64` / `magpie-linux-arm64` (needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1)
- **Terminal only:** `magpie-cli-<os>-<arch>`

Thanks to Arobotmaster, whose reports and code went into this release. Everyone who helped: [contributors](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/contributors).

<!-- lang:zh -->

## 功能
- Antigravity 现在支持在 `.agents/hooks.json` 中定义的项目钩子和子代理。

### 安装

从 [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai) 下载，或运行 `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`。已安装的 magpie 会自动更新。

感谢 Arobotmaster：这次更新里有你的反馈与代码。所有贡献者见[贡献墙](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/zh/contributors)。

name: FlClash
body:
<!-- flclash:changelog:begin -->
### Features
- **concord** The Android app no longer crashes about a second after start when a plain DNS server answers
- **concord** AnyTLS downloads take less CPU
- **core** Start without a profile: all traffic goes direct, with HTTPS decryption, modules and capture still working
- **update** Check for and install updates from the rs test releases
- **proxies** Support smart proxy groups, which pick a node per site and switch to the next one when it fails, and the config editor offers them with their own options
- **requests** A connection's timeline shows which rule in the list routed it, when each step of setting it up happened with the DNS lookup and handshake times, the DNS lookups that gave its address, and why it ended or why its dial failed; a DNS query's details list the connections that used it, DNS queries that apps send show App as their initiator, and connections opened after the desktop core restarts no longer go missing from the requests page
- **requests** Captured HTTP requests show the rule and chain each took, what answered or rewrote them and which module made each change, their status with its reason phrase, the header rewrite lines that acted, and each body's size and type; the HTTP segment shows only while decryption and capture are on, and HTTP capture moves into the requests menu
- **dns** With "Append system DNS" on, a module that replaces the nameservers no longer drops the system resolver.
- **mitm** MITM scripts that rewrite gRPC responses keep grpc-status, scripts that ask for full-header-mode run, a script's max-size can exceed one body's limit, and a script's $notification.post shows as a banner in the app while it is in front, opening its link after a confirmation.
- **mitm** MITM modules are read, merged and fetched by the core: the module page shows each line as the core reads it, SCRIPT rules and rule and dns scripts included, lists each module's remote files and fetches them again, says how many

name: opencode
body:
### Highlights

- **Built-In Desktop Browser**: Import your sign-ins and browsing history from Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, and add extensions from Chromium browsers or the Chrome and Edge stores. Everything stays in one persistent desktop profile: chat links open signed in, your tabs survive restarts and the agent can read and drive the same pages without you switching apps. ([#63002](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63002), [#65073](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65073))
- **Automations**: Ask the agent to run a prompt, a script or a shell command on a timer, on a cron schedule or when an MCP server sends an event, and manage them with `/automation`. Set `"automations": false` in your config if you don't want them. ([#65296](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65296), [#65186](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65186))
- **Generate Videos**: When a connected provider has a video model, the agent can make videos with `generate_video`. It keeps working while the video renders and saves the files into your workspace when they're ready. ([#63666](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/63666), [#65664](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65664))
- **New TUI Look**: The TUI's new designs are on by default, and the `opencode` theme is the new one. Pick `opencode-classic` in **Theme** to keep the previous colors. ([#64988](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/64988))
- **Windows Taskbar Status**: On Windows, the taskbar button shows session progress, counts sessions that need you and flashes when a permission or question is waiting. ([#65317](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65317), [#65318](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65318), [#65319](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/65319))

### Upgrade notes

- **Image tool renamed.** `experimental_image_generate` is now `generate_image`. Permission rules with the old name are mapped automatically, but saved "always allow" approvals are not, so

name: motrix-next
body:
## What's Changed

This beta bundles Aria2 Next 3.1.2, so deleting or pausing a download the engine is still stopping no longer fails, and adding a link again continues its unfinished file. It also adds a collapsible sidebar, the native edit menu in text fields and a refreshed Windows installer. Use it with Rayburst Connect 2.2.2.

### ✨ New Features

- **Collapsible sidebar** — a button at the bottom of the sidebar collapses it to icons; the choice is remembered (#839)
- **Edit menu in text fields** — right-clicking an input or text area opens the system menu with cut, copy, paste and select all (#837)
- **Windows installer artwork** — the installer's welcome and finish pages show Rayburst artwork, and the uninstaller uses the app icon (#836)

### 🛠 Improvements

- **Resuming** — adding a link again after its unfinished download was removed continues the file instead of saving a new copy, when the server shows the same file (#842)
- **Dialogs** — the extension dialog's content comes in item by item, as in About
- **Brand mark** — a slightly larger mark and name at the top of the sidebar
- **Engine** — Aria2 Next 3.1.2: stops that could hang after a failed disk write are fixed, large Linux preallocations stop promptly, slow stops and disk operations are logged, and path options expand `${HOME}`

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed deleting a download that the engine was still stopping, for example while it retried after HTTP 429. The task leaves the list at once and its files are removed when the engine lets go of them, instead of failing with a timeout and coming back (#832)
- Fixed Pause All reporting an error when the engine took longer than its wait to pause everything (#832)

### 📦 Downloads

| Platform | Architecture          | File                      |
| -------- | --------------------- | ------------------------- |
| macOS    | Apple Silicon · Intel | `.dmg`                    |
| Windows  | x64 · ARM64           | `-setup.exe`              |
| Linux    | x64 · ARM64

name: aliyunpan
body:
# BoxPlayer 5.0.48

## 简体中文

- 网盘文件直播放进度单独保存，并可从首页「继续观看」续播。
- 修复没有画质选项时部分网盘视频无法播放的问题。
- 从独立媒体服务器详情开始播放时恢复剧集列表。
- 重新创建百度网盘下载任务时刷新下载链接。
- 将账号、服务请求和官网入口切换到 boxplayer.cc。

## 繁體中文

- 直接播放網路磁碟檔案的進度會獨立儲存，可從首頁「繼續觀看」續播。
- 修正沒有畫質選項時部分網路磁碟影片無法播放的問題。
- 從獨立媒體伺服器詳情開始播放時恢復集數清單。
- 重新建立百度網路磁碟下載任務時更新下載連結。
- 將帳號、服務請求及官網入口切換至 boxplayer.cc。

## English

- Save separate cloud file playback progress and resume from Continue Watching.
- Fix cloud video playback when a source offers no quality selector.
- Restore the episode list when starting playback from standalone media server details.
- Refresh Baidu download links when recreating download jobs.
- Move account, service, and website endpoints to boxplayer.cc.

[Download links are at the bottom](#two-editions-one-cleaner). > [!IMPORTANT] > **Using Winapp3?** Turning it on ticked all of its rules, also the ones that delete across the whole drive. One of you lost several apps that way. Now nothing from Winapp3 starts ticked, in Modern and Classic, but your old ticks stay until you pick **Restore default state**. In Modern it's in the cleaner's `∨` menu and resets all your ticks. In Classic, right-click each category. - **A bit more CCleaner.** I put the old one next to FluentCleaner and took what it did right. Status, progress and size are above the results, after Analyze it tells you nothing has been deleted yet, and categories and entries have a right-click menu. - **Devs, this one's for you.** New Developer Tools category: npm, Yarn, pnpm, pip, uv, Cargo, Go, NuGet, Gradle, Maven, vcpkg, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, Docker Desktop. All the junk our builds leave behind. - **Two old bugs.** The Recycle Bin icon stayed full after emptying, and bins on drives other than C: were never touched. Both there since day one. Took two of you to notice. - **Gone.** The PowerShell scripts in Custom. They ran blind with no preview, bad idea in a cleaner. > [!NOTE] > **Modern or Classic?** I once asked which one you prefer, and right now the ugly one is winning. Yes, Classic :D Modern changed a lot since then: native build, opens in about 126 ms, takes 17 MB. Still team Classic? name: WWPlayer
body:
## 新功能

- 新增沉浸首页，和无边框全屏切换按钮。
- 内置播放器支持 AI 翻译文本字幕。
- 新增 ASSRT 在线字幕源，需配置个人 API Key。
- 详情页支持分别选择并记住影片的海报、背景和标题 Logo。
- 播放器支持自定义下一集的预加载时机。

## 优化

- 播放控制栏显示时仍可手动跳过片头和片尾。
- 停止使用nextup。
- 在线字幕下载在触发人机验证时使用回退路径下载，时长较长。

## 修复

- 修复部分 WebDAV 条目在起播准备时丢失文件位置，以及部分远程 ISO 和 STRM 因服务器错误无法尝试其他可用来源的问题。
- 修复无效服务器合集进入分页、演员搜索混入非人物结果，以及使用右键菜单时搜索框意外收起的问题。

name: MoviePilot
body:
## 本次更新内容

- **智能助手 / WebAgent 放开普通用户并绑定实时权限（后端 + 前端）**：
  - 放开 WebAgent 与网页消息接口（`POST /api/v1/message/web`）给普通激活用户使用，取消默认的管理员上下文；智能助手按当前登录用户的实时权限（`discovery`、`search`、`subscribe`、`manage` 及各功能级 `features` 开关）校验白名单业务 API、工具与子代理调用，账号停用或权限调整后即时生效。
  - 非管理员会话自动隐藏管理员工具、插件工具、后台 `Jobs` 任务与宿主机路径/命令信息，并在系统提示词中注入当前账号真实权限边界；禁止普通用户读写 `agent/jobs` 及修改 Agent 公共文件，同时放行只读读取本人会话上传的临时附件。
  - 前端智能助手面板仅对超级管理员加载并展示斜杠命令补全，避免普通用户输入 `/` 时触发管理员权限报错，并在切换账号或角色时自动清空缓存。
- **下载任务与下载历史按用户隔离（后端）**：
  - 具备搜索或订阅权限的普通网页用户可查看本人发起的正在下载任务与下载历史记录，并严格按当前登录用户隔离；管理员及具备「正在下载」管理权限的用户保持全局视图。
- **前端界面视觉与对比度优化（前端）**：
  - 优化运营卡片、媒体卡片、横向导航及浅色玻璃主题的自适应语义色板与主色对比度，提升亮暗主题下的一致性与可读性。
- **其他优化（后端）**：
  - 补齐接口错误提示多语言翻译，并完成 Fanart 图片语言记录辅助方法拆分与架构门禁对齐。

## 完整变更记录

- refactor(fanart): extract image language recording helper to satisfy complexity ratchet by @jxxghp ([e435fea](https://github.com/jxxghp/MoviePilot/commit/e435fea7abdbb06fcf7c994bac9982e478911094))
- feat(agent): enforce real-time per-user permissions for WebAgent and Web chat by @jxxghp ([cc0ebd9](https://github.com/jxxghp/MoviePilot/commit/cc0ebd9252c98037ac02f686ec8859bcd45d3f3e))
- fix(agent): align locale, evaluation harness, complexity, and dependency baseline by @jxxghp ([63e9ee7](https://github.com/jxxghp/MoviePilot/commit/63e9ee796f4a3297db8cbda08083ad2f404ad82c))
- chore(release): publish v3.2.11 by @jxxghp ([e13da2b](https://github.com/jxxghp/MoviePilot/commit/e13da2b8a873ae097fca7af897dc7ef17a179868))
- fix(architecture): satisfy concurrency, ruff, and architecture overview gates by @jxxghp ([448e6a3](https://github.com/jxxghp/MoviePilot/commit/448e6a39e4d47ca92ad18c74b44257499cec5f12))

name: Capso
body:
Quicker window selection in All-in-One, undo shortcuts while annotating a capture, and a fix for dragging screenshots out of Quick Access.

## New
- **All-in-One:** hover a window to highlight it and click to select it, without switching to Window mode. Dragging still draws a freeform area. ([#409](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/409))
- **Capture annotations:** ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z now undo and redo annotations in the All-in-One capture overlay. ([#408](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/408))

## Fixes
- **Quick Access:** a screenshot dragged into Finder or a browser now arrives. With Close After Dragging on, the file was removed before the other app could read it, so Finder showed error -43 and uploads failed. ([#412](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/412))
- **Annotate editor:** ⌘Z while typing a text annotation now undoes the typing. Before, it undid the previous annotation on the canvas. ([#408](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/408))
- **Translation:** the translation card can be dragged by its header, so it no longer stays over the text it is translating. ([#400](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/400))
- **Self-timer:** the countdown follows the pointer when you drag it. Before, it trailed behind. ([#407](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/407))
- **Settings:** the Export Quality and Close After pickers stay inside their rows in languages with longer labels. ([#406](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/406))

## Other
- Capso is now licensed under MIT. ([#403](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/pull/403))

Thanks to @jiagenli for window hover selection, to @Sheldontao for the translation card fix, and to @ejdub, @busyhe and @treee111 for reporting issues!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso/compare/v1.2.8...v1.2.9

name: OptiScaler-DLSSNR-PreSR-Multipass
body:
### OptiScaler (`OptiScaler-NR-v0.9.6.zip`, or `OptiScaler-NR-v0.9.6-rtx40-mfg.zip` with the experimental RTX 40 MFG unlock)

- Add INT8 NR models for RTX 30, 40 and 50 series GPUs on the D3D12 path: "INT8 Original" and "INT8 2xPass-in-one" (the look of two passes in one). They run wholly on kernels of this project and use no NR runtime. The files are in OptiScaler/nvfp4/int8.
- The INT8 models have been run on an RTX 50 series GPU only. They have not yet been tested on an RTX 30 or 40 series GPU.
- The NR model list is sorted by the precision of the weights: FP8, INT8, NVFP4. NVIDIA's own models are now listed as "FP8 Original" and "FP8 Optimized".
- Add a model comparison: Compare (side by side or wipe) has a new "Other side" setting that puts one pass of another NR model beside the NR picture, in place of the original picture. With "Label the sides" each side carries its model's name.
- Add 4K versions of the pass-in-one models beside the existing ones: "NVFP4 2xPass-in-one 4K", "NVFP4 3xPass-in-one 4K", "FP8 2xPass-in-one 4K" and "FP8 3xPass-in-one 4K". They give the looks of the 2xPass-in-one and 3xPass-in-one models with weights made for 4K output.
- Like the other NVFP4 and FP8 models the 4K models carry all their own weights and take none from the NR runtime, so they work with any NR runtime that offers the original model (preset 1), including 310.8.0 and 310.9.16.0.
- The FP8 models have not yet been tested on an RTX 40 series GPU.
- Suggested settings for the 2xPass-in-one and 3xPass-in-one models (NVFP4 and FP8, 4K or not): Cinematic, with Local structure lowered to 0.5 and Local tone lowered to 0.8.

### Display Filter (`display-filter-v0.7.0-preview.zip`)

v0.9.5（605） (2026-11-22)
[改进] 适配 Compose 1.13 的窗口姿态媒体查询与 LazyGrid 缓存窗口预取开关，保持折叠屏姿态识别、铰链几何回退和普通网格预取行为不变。
[改进] 更新 Miuix 组件库快照版本。
[新增] 新增首次启动向导流程，集中引导外观风格、核心交互偏好与协议确认；优化用户协议与官方渠道免责声明弹窗排版，避免 Miuix 等分操作槽中按钮文字折行错位。
[改进] 合并主界面、视频播放页、竖屏流与播放浮层的多项独立 DataStore 订阅并缓存同步初值，复用动态卡片时间格式化器及热点正则表达式，减少组合期重复分配。
[修复] 子评论预览中点击换行后的被回复人昵称或普通文本统一打开楼中楼详情，不再误触跳转个人空间。该修复由 [@CoderTCY](https://github.com/CoderTCY) 贡献。
[改进] 听视频播放进度与直播间实时看过/高能观众统计从顶层页面状态解耦为独立数据流，仅由进度条、歌词和直播顶栏局部订阅；视频播放浮层仅在开启播放洞察模式时订阅高频诊断信息。
[改进] 弹幕蒙版离屏图层收紧至可见弹幕包围盒，滚动弹幕推进与离屏回收合并为单遍遍历，复用蒙版路径、UP 主徽章测量与贴图滤镜对象。
[改进] 自定义字体改为后台异步加载并缓存字体族，关注列表与今日推荐偏好读写移至 IO 线程，Google Cast 上下文改为异步获取，公共内容图片加载器接入内存分级回收，降低主线程阻塞与后台内存占用。
[改进] 视频卡片返回落位回弹与「一镜到底接口」共用同一按布局解析的压缩幅度，切换接口不再改变落位手感；提交返回的压缩峰提前压住落位尾巴，冲量随松手速度缩放，甩手返回落位更深，返回键与程序化返回保持基线手感。
[改进] 动态侧栏直播区域展开与收起增加过渡，头像淡入淡出，其余条目随位置变化平滑移动。
[改进] 首页关注直播条在接口返回总页数时并发拉取剩余页，缩短关注条就绪时间；直播页刷新指示器随推荐内容就绪结束，不再等待关注补取。
[修复] 导航卡片窗口（设置、个人主页等）内不再嵌套打开同类窗口，避免头像等入口层层堆叠窗口；窗口初始内容为底栏目的地时，底栏选中项绑定窗口内容身份，头像入口直达「我的」。
[修复] 竖屏全屏隐藏状态栏后，顶部控件按挖孔实际高度避让并贴近挖孔，减少对视频画面的遮挡；原生与玻璃顶栏同步。
[修复] 空间投稿排序芯片使用与菜单一致的文案，最多播放、最多收藏排序不再显示「播放发布」「收藏发布」。

name: nv-uefi-unlocker
body:
**rc6 的 SLOT-REVIVE 在 #276 机器上 declined at parent matching（死槽 bus 2 不在根口当前 [0,0] 范围内——固件把 PEG 口的总线寄存器清零了；PORT-DIAG boot 1 裁决：DLLLA=1 Gen3 x16 链路训练着、D0、无 LinkDisable、secbus=0x00）。rc7 两处修复：

1. **父口匹配路径化**：固件 device path 前缀匹配优先（编号无关），bus 包含判降级为路径不可读时的 fallback；
2. **重编号族从 decline 升级为行动杠杆**：把死槽记录的总线号写回父口 sec/sub（读回验证）→ reprobe——若 vendor 读回干净 = 设备只是被路由隔离、从未断电（config 内容含 BARs 完好），无需复位直接保留候选、同 boot 交易；仍 0xffff 才落 SBR 阶梯（此时 config TLP 已恢复路由、杠杆可达）。

**给 #276 报告者：直接替换 U 盘 BOOTX64.EFI（TX 版 sha 8c57db7c…200d），markers 保持原样再 boot 一轮。预期：SLOT-REVIVE 按 ROM 身份识别 02:00.0（N 卡）→ bus 恢复 → vendor 读回 0x10de → 同 boot 交易全链 → 系统内 ssdiag 裁决。**（只读负控版随行）；zip/ssdiag 沿用 rc6（未变）。**


------

## English summary

**v2.1.12-rc7 (pre-release) — the #276 renumbering-family fix: path-based parent matching + a bus-restore-first lever.**

rc6's SLOT-REVIVE declined at parent matching on the #276 machine (the dead function's bus 2 was not inside the PEG port's current [0,0] range — the firmware ZEROED the PEG port's bus registers; PORT-DIAG boot 1 adjudicated: DLLLA=1, Gen3 x16 trained, D0, no Link Disable, secbus=0x00). Two fixes:

1. **Path-based parent matching**: firmware device-path prefix matching first (numbering-independent); bus-range containment demoted to a fallback for handles with unreadable paths.
2. **The renumbering family is an active lever now, not a decline**: write the dead function's recorded bus back into the port's secondary/subordinate registers (readback-verified), then reprobe. If the vendor reads clean, the device was ROUTING-ISOLATED, never dead — its config space content (BARs included) survived intact, **no reset and no bookkeeping restore is needed, the slot stays in the candidate list and the transaction runs same-boot**. If it still reads 0xffff, the ladder falls through to the SBR levers, now reachable because config TLPs route again.

name: moonlight-vplus
body:
## 🌙 Moonlight V+ 12.15.33

本次更新汇总 **v12.15.17 之后至 v12.15.33** 的改动。

本次更新重点改善王冠配置与商店、性能监控、键盘和鼠标输入、串流返回菜单以及设备兼容性。输入体验方面，新增实体键盘输入支持、虚拟屏幕键盘与本机键盘互斥，以及相对鼠标和绝对鼠标切换；其中相对鼠标适用于游戏画面中的视角旋转，绝对鼠标可以让鼠标更加跟手，适合远程桌面和需要直接定位指针的场景。

**建议使用配套的 [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine)，以获得最佳兼容性和完整的输入、触觉反馈体验。**

本次更新中的许多需求来自社区和基地群聊用户的反馈，感谢大家帮助 Moonlight V+ 持续改善使用体验。

欢迎给项目点一个 Star ⭐ 或赞助项目加速开发。新功能的界面与操作流程仍在持续优化，欢迎通过 Issue 提交问题和建议。

### 👑 王冠配置与商店

- 完善王冠面板、配置编辑器和商店交互，支持更直观的配置预览；切换配置时先选择再确认，导入成功后进入本地配置，**不会自动启用**。从游戏菜单进入编辑后，退出会返回王冠页面。([#855](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/855)、[#877](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/877))
- 修复王冠开关无法点击或无法通过手柄焦点操作的问题，并将王冠功能说明放到主列表标题位置。([#849](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/849)、[#850](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/850))
- 补充王冠配置标签翻译，改善不同语言下的配置识别。([#876](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/876))

### 📊 性能监控

- 串流菜单可以调整性能监控样式、指标和手势。手势提供「完整」和「仅长按」两种模式，新安装默认使用完整手势，已有自定义组合继续保留。位置和默认方向可以在应用设置中调整。([#853](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/853)、[#862](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/862))
- 收口性能监控菜单 UI 和公共开关样式，统一相关弹窗图标与设置控件显示。([#868](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/868)、[#870](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/870))

### ⌨️ 输入与键盘

- Android 16.1 及以上支持在串流画面中直接使用实体键盘输入，适用于主串流窗口和外接显示器；系统保留按键仍由 Android 处理。([#863](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/863)、[#866](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/866))
- **默认设置变化：**未保存过相关选项的设备，自动弹出电脑触摸键盘默认关闭；本机键盘仍默认自动弹出，已有设置保持不变。([#856](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/856))
- 虚拟屏幕键盘和本机系统键盘现在互斥。打开虚拟键盘时会自动收起系统键盘，切换到系统键盘时会先关闭虚拟键盘，避免两个键盘叠加遮挡。([#887](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/887))
- 优化自定义按键名称编辑、按键列表刷新和悬浮球长按行为。编辑完成后会收起输入法，添加或删除按键后立即刷新列表，悬浮球长按默认改为无动作。([#879](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vplus/pull/879))
- 修复串流暂停、切换输入捕获和无障碍输入时可能出现的卡键、输入丢失或按键序列归属错误。([#865](https://github.com/qiin2333/moonlight-vpl

name: MFGAdaUnlock-RenoDx
body:
Fixes from two weeks of reports on 1.10.1, and a performance overlay. The games named were tested by their reporters, not by us, unless said otherwise.

## Performance overlay

An on-screen display drawn over the game, also with the ReShade menu closed. It is off by default: turn it on with **Shift+F10** or under **General → Performance overlay**.

- **Minimal:** the output frame rate, and the game's own frame rate when frames are generated ("191 FPS (game 48)").
- **Standard** (the default when on): adds the frame time average, 99th percentile and maximum, the 1% and 0.1% lows, hitches over 50 ms, and the frame generation method with its status in words (DLSS-G's multiplier and status flags, why XeMFG DLSS-G is not generating, XeMFG's state).
- **Full:** adds a frame time graph, PC latency and its 95th percentile, GPU time, the display rate and video memory against the budget.

Position, size, background opacity and the shortcut are in its section; changes apply at once. A game in which the overlay is never turned on pays nothing for it: ReShade draws its UI every frame only once an addon asks to draw, so the overlay asks the first time it is turned on.

## Add frame generation

- **With RenoDX's DLSS addon (Lies of P, Hi-Fi RUSH).** Frame generation stopped after a few seconds with "Compatibility issue" (DLSS-G: Reflex not detected). RenoDX's DLSS addon creates the game's swap chain on MFG Unlock's Streamline, and MFG Unlock then put a second Streamline swap chain under it, so DLSS-G saw two presents per frame. Now there is one, and frame generation paces from it. Keep RenoDX DLSS on. Reproduced and fixed in an automated test; confirmed on Lies of P by its reporter only without the addon so far.

name: RTX40MFG-Unlock
body:
**V1.7.2 is a bugfix release built from your V1.7.1 reports. It fixes the Cyberpunk 2077 exit crash and a long list of game crashes, lets XeMFG standalone swap in for a game's own DLSS Frame Generation, should stop Windows Defender flagging the DLL, and brings every fix from the V1.7.2 betas and the release candidate.**

To update, close the game and replace the installed `MFGUnlocker.dll` (or `MFGUnlocker.asi` in `OptiScaler\plugins`) with the new one, keeping its filename. Your settings carry over. With OptiScaler, also take our OptiScaler build, [OptiScaler for MFG Unlocker V1.7.2](https://github.com/dashdogy/OptiScaler/releases/tag/mfgunlocker-v1.7.2) (see OptiScaler below).

## Changes since V1.7.1

**Crashes**
- **Quitting Cyberpunk 2077** no longer crashes: MFG Unlocker lets go of its Streamline plug-ins before the game shuts Streamline down.
- **A Plague Tale: Resonance** should no longer crash at launch with OptiScaler.

# CC Switch v4.0.39

本版本以修复为主。**API Key 输入框**加了复制按钮；**备份**可以设置总大小上限，超过时从最旧的开始删；Claude Code 经 Codex OAuth 使用 **GPT-6.2 Sol / Astra** 时，系统提示的缓存命中率大幅提高。

另外修复了 Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop 的原生供应商卡住不出字时，要等最长 600 秒才故障转移；很长的流式响应让用量和日志收集占用的内存一直增长；一键导入链接合并配置失败后仍弹出确认框；只装了 Codex 桌面版时，插件页显示「未安装 Codex」；插件页给没装的应用建了空配置文件夹；OpenCode Go 的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 缺少 `max` 思考档位；快速点击时弹出层和下拉菜单闪烁等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.39-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.39-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### API Key 输入框可以一键复制

供应商表单的 API Key 输入框旁边多了复制按钮（[#9232](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9232)），复制的是去掉首尾空格后的 Key，成功或失败都会提示。输入框为空或不可编辑时不显示。

### 备份总大小上限

备份设置里新增「备份总大小上限」（[#9011](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9011)，相关 [#6706](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6706)），默认「不限制」，升级后不会删任何备份。

- 设置上限后，备份文件夹超过这个大小时，会从最旧的备份开始删除。
- 最新的一份备份和恢复正在使用的备份始终保留，所以单份备份比上限还大时，文件夹仍可能超过上限。
- 上限在下次备份或每日维护时生效。每日维护还会清理备份中途崩溃留下、超过 24 小时的临时文件。

- **隐私过滤器更快**（[#9826](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9826)）：过滤结果不变。

---

## 修复

- **Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop 的原生供应商卡住不出字时，最长要等 600 秒才故障转移**（[#9754](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9754)）：这类流式请求用的是非流式请求的超时，现在和其他流式请求一样用首字超时（默认 60 秒）。

body:
### 新增

- **评论发表情**：播放器评论区与图文动态详情各加一颗「表情」按钮，点开内嵌表情墙，点一下就把表情插到光标处。表情按账号下发，大会员能用的包也会跟着变；退出登录后缓存自动清空。
- **评论 tab 显示评论总数**：直接用 view 接口里已有的 `stat.reply`，不新增请求；数量为 0 或未知时小标签自动收起。

### 修复

- **鼠标点画面暂停后画面冻结**（[#119](https://github.com/ABING1111/BiliDesk/issues/119)）：libvlc 3.0.24 在 NVIDIA 显卡上暂停再恢复时，解码器的输出缓冲会被占满，音频继续走而画面永久停在最后一帧（上游 3.0.25 才修）。现在加了看门狗：画面 4 秒不涨但媒体时钟在走，就用软解重建当前播放，原地恢复到当前进度。另在 **设置 → 兼容性 → 硬件解码** 加了开关，可永久关闭硬解规避。
- **多P 视频自动连播跳过后续分P**：连播队列新增分P链，优先级改为 分P → 合集/番剧 → 相关视频，看完第 1 P 会接着播第 2 P，而不是跳去相关视频。
- **分P 面板随滚动漂移或悬空**：弹层锚点改到不滚动的信息栏外层，按按钮当前屏幕坐标定位；右缘夹回窗口内，放不下自动翻到上方；信息栏自身滚动时收起弹层。80%~150% 缩放都正常。
- **鼠标压在楼中楼上滚轮滚不动**：楼中楼预览框里每条回复的根节点取不到逻辑父，滚轮被内部 RichTextBox 吃掉。改为逻辑父优先、取不到再沿可视树找模板根起跳。
- **动态卡「更多」按钮顶着一块灰底**：常态改为只露三个点，菜单打开时才有底色，开着且悬停再深一档。

### 改进

- **聆听态去掉强调色高亮**，只保留文案变化；铺满窗口按钮去掉常态半透明底。

body:
### Changed

- The `programming` skill's language gate now routes rendered web work (`.html`, `.css`, `.jsx`, `.tsx`, `.vue`, `.svelte`, `.astro`, or any task that ships a UI) to the `frontend` skill before the first line of UI code. It tells the agent to take the look from the frontend skill's references when there is no design direction (no named brand, reference, `DESIGN.md`, or existing styled UI to match), and to finish only after `visual-qa` passes on the rendered surface. ([#14604](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14604), fixes [#14602](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14602))

### Fixed

- Memory sync: a sign-out now retires the trust pin of the account it signs out of, so `omo account show --account <id>` no longer answers `joined` once that sign-in's keys are gone. Plain `omo account forget` (the desktop's sign-out of a CLI-item session) used to retire nothing. It now reads the stored sign-in first to find its account. A stored sign-in that cannot be read is still deleted and its pin is left; one warning line is printed only after the delete succeeds. A forget that fails on a locked store reports only that error (#12308, #12384). ([#13642](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13642)) ([#14533](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14533))
- Memory sync: some sign-ins earned their pin before `omo sync` recorded their account. On a refused refresh, plain `forget`, `forget --device` and `adopt --replace`, omo now asks the service for that account, as `omo logout` already did, and retires the pin when the service names it. It asks only while a live pin exists and the access token has not expired; on a refused refresh, the token may still be valid in the 30 s before expiry, when the refresh runs. An expired token is never sent. A pin whose account stays unknown is kept, and omo prints one line naming `omo account retire-sync --account <id>` to clear it, because `omo account show` keeps ans

name: NOIR
body:
# NOIR v0.4.5 — offline APK audit & explain

This release adds a device-free APK audit mode, batch explanations from existing reports, machine-readable doctor output, and a user-app-only scan filter.

## Highlights

- **`noir apk <file|dir>`** — audit APK files without a phone or adb:
  - parse `AndroidManifest.xml` for package, targetSdk, debuggable, and permissions;
  - statically extract endpoints from `classes*.dex`;
  - merge split APKs by package;
  - write the same `report.json` / `.md` / `.html` / `.csv` and domain lists as a device scan.
  - Verified on a 124 MB YouTube APK: 11 sensitive permissions, 190 endpoints, 0.21 s.
- **Batch `noir explain`** — `noir explain` explains the top 10 flagged apps; `--top N`, `--all`, and multiple explicit package names are supported. Batch mode is compact by default; `--full` expands evidence and `--json` emits an array.
- **`noir doctor --json`** — platform, Docker, adb, jadx, devices, and an overall `ok` flag for CI and bug reports.
- **`--user-only`** — scan only user-installed apps, skipping system packages while keeping the same permission/endpoint pipeline.

## Upgrade notes

1. Portable users: download the asset for your platform and replace the old directory.
2. Scoop users: `scoop update noir`.
3. Offline reports go to `noir-apk/` by default; use `--out` to choose another directory.
4. Verify `SHA256SUMS.txt` before running any downloaded build.

WinGet packaging is still waiting for Microsoft moderator approval; use the portable build or Scoop for now.

name: Mole
body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. Cleaning progress names the item: `mo clean` shows the section, the position and the item being removed, such as `Cleaning User app cache 3/12 · com.microsoft…ShipIt`, so a long removal no longer looks stuck. 2. Online-only folders are skipped: iCloud placeholders in Documents, online-only CloudStorage providers and Next.js cache entries that live only in the cloud are no longer downloaded during `mo clean`, which ends the hangs and the skipped CloudStorage project caches. 3. Accurate totals: Rows that print their own size and the space Homebrew cleanup reports freeing now count in the `mo clean` total. 4. Previews name what they skipped: `mo clean --dry-run` ends with the families it left out while Xcode or the Simulator was open, so a later real run no longer removes paths the preview never listed. 5. Clearer memory diagnosis: `mo optimize` judges memory by the macOS pressure level instead of swap use and lists the apps holding the most on one line, and WindowServer and CoreSimulator disk images are no longer reported as bottlenecks. 6. Safer cleanup: A privileged helper is not offered when Spotlight cannot confirm its app is gone, `mo analyze` refuses to move the temporary folders ssh-agent and tmux depend on, and apps without a `Contents` folder, such as NetBird, no longer skip App leftovers. 7. More caches and records: Postman HTTP and code caches are cleaned, cleanups run through gh, go, simctl, tart and Homebrew appear in `mo history`, and terminals that support OSC 7501 show the cleanup state. 8. name: ControllerMeta
body:
[ZH]
- 新增高级扳机检测与 256 分度采样面板，支持外侧扳机唯一值持续检测、点击重置以及 HID 扳机合轴提示。
- 新增设备底层协议与驱动检测及屏蔽过滤功能，可在设备详情中查看物理设备的协议与驱动信息，并按需屏蔽指定虚拟或过滤驱动手柄。
- 优化按键与曲线工具体验，方向键窜键检测新增独立计入开关，补偿曲线生成支持数值取整，同时修复 8ms 推送频率未真正生效的问题。
- 增强运行环境诊断与引导，新增 WebView2 运行库缺失或异常时的原生修复引导，完善 GameInput 扳机震动提示与设置指南链接。
- 支持 OBS 覆盖层自定义 CSS 样式变量，并补充对应的双语模板说明文档。
- 优化界面加载性能与整体稳定性，本地化字体资源消除首屏网络阻塞，强化覆盖层安全边界并改进 HID 断联去重与刷新表现。

[EN]
- Added advanced trigger testing with a 256-step sampling panel, continuous outer-value tracking with click-to-reset, and an HID combined-trigger axis notice.
- Added underlying protocol and driver inspection alongside controller filtering, allowing you to view physical device protocol/driver details and block specific virtual or filter-driver devices.
- Refined testing and curve tools with an independent counting toggle for D-pad crosstalk detection, integer rounding for generated compensation curves, and a fix so the 8ms push rate takes effect properly.
- Enhanced runtime diagnostics and guidance with native repair prompts for missing or broken WebView2 runtimes, clearer GameInput trigger rumble notices, and direct links to setup guides.
- Supported custom CSS variables for OBS overlays with accompanying bilingual template documentation.
- Improved startup performance and overall stability by bundling fonts locally to remove initial load blocking, tightening overlay security boundaries, and refining HID disconnect deduplication and refresh behavior.

name: just-the-browser
body:
This update contains changes to the **Chrome** configuration and **Microsoft Edge** configuration. You can [install Just the Browser](https://justthebrowser.com/) again to get the latest version. Existing users on other browsers do not need to update.

### Configuration settings
- Google Chrome's [shopping list and price tracking features](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/11625545) are now disabled with the `ShoppingListEnabled` policy
- Google Chrome promotional alerts are now disabled with the `PromotionsEnabled` policy, which includes "welcome pages that help users sign in to Google Chrome, set Google Chrome as users' default browser, or otherwise inform them of product features."
- Google Chrome's [Try On You feature](https://www.google.com/shopping/tryon) for virtually trying on clothing images found on the web is now disabled with the `TryOnYouSettings` policy
- Microsoft Edge's [Remix feature](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/edge/web-remix-in-microsoft-edge) that uses a local AI model to modify webpages is now disabled with the `RemixAvailability` policy
- Microsoft Edge is now blocked from sending tab content to Copilot with the `BlueprintGWAAvailability` policy
- Microsoft Edge's machine learning autofill suggestions are now blocked with the `EdgeAutofillMlEnabled` policy

### Installation scripts
- Donation page is now opened when exiting the installer
- Windows installer now uses a `-BaseUrl` parameter for local testing

name: dsh-Go
body:
**手机安装：只需下载 [`dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk`](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/download/v1.3.0/dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk)。**

`update.json` 和 `SHA256SUMS` 供自动更新与校验使用，无需手动下载。GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 是源码包，不是安装包。

**Install on your phone: download [`dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk`](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/download/v1.3.0/dsh-go-1.3.0-arm64.apk).**

`update.json` and `SHA256SUMS` support automatic updates and verification. You do not need to download them manually. GitHub's Source code archives are not installers.

### 中文

- **顶栏一键语音通话。** 首页右上角、新对话按钮旁边多了通话按钮，新对话里也能直接打。
- **长按就能选字。** 长按回复或自己发的消息直接选中按到的词，拖两端改范围；选区上有复制、引用、分享、朗读、全选，「更多」里是原来的消息菜单。自己发的消息也能引用了。朗读选中的文字时，里面的密码、密钥不会念出来。
- **远程主机：对话备份和网页版。** 远程主机页可以把主机上的对话加密备份到手机，再恢复到原来的或另一台主机（每次恢复新建对话，不覆盖；附件和工作区源码不迁移）。主机支持时，还能在 App 里直接打开主机的 DSH 网页版，不用把登录凭据交给浏览器；服务繁忙时会提示「人太多了，请稍后重试」。
- **后台保护（需要自己打开）。** 设置里新增后台运行保护，默认关闭。打开后本机长任务切到后台更不容易被系统杀掉，被系统收回时如实显示，不会假装还在运行。iOS 可以选静音音频或后台定位来保活，都要自己授权，不保存也不上传位置。
- **酒馆。**
  - 支持酒馆助手脚本库：全局、预设、角色卡里的脚本都能运行。预设的脚本能拿到 SillyTavern 的事件和当前预设，像小猫之神这类预设的菜单现在能出来；脚本面板在画布里显示，开关会写回预设。
  - 大卡明显不卡了：重卡导入、卡库列表、长历史显示快了数倍，卡库占用减少约三分之二。前端卡只渲染屏幕上看得见的消息，写回复时少了很多多余重建。新增「省电渲染」开关（酒馆设置 › 显示，默认关）：关掉卡片网页里的毛玻璃，循环动画只播一遍。
  - 上下文满了一次裁掉一截，而不是每条都裁，模型的缓存能持续命中，更快也更省钱（默认开）。
  - 前端卡的开场白不再显示成一堆代码；深色模式下卡片颜色和网页文字看得清；酒馆界面统一了间距、样式和文案，加了克制的动效。
- **伙伴小屋更清晰。** 小屋按屏幕本身的像素密度渲染（之前最多按 2 倍），卡顿时临时降低的清晰度流畅后会自己升回来。
- **新桌宠「小粉鱼」。** 第三只内置宠物，带 18 种状态动画和 3 段待机小动作；切换动作时淡入淡出。
- **分享长图。** 分享成图片时保留完整正文，生成一张长图，不再截掉后半段。
- **本机引擎默认用 tawcroot 启动**（Android 10 及以上）：启动更快；起不来会自动退回原来的兼容启动（PRoot），不弹故障卡。之前手动关过的保持原样。卓易通上 PRoot 启动失败时，故障卡上会出现「用 tawcroot 启动」。
- **修复。** 升级到 1.1.0 后本机新建对话失败；本机用久了会话列表超过 8 MB 就整个加载失败；配了多台 DNS 时第一台拒绝就联网失败；插件配置里 API Key 填不进去；Android 10 用 Shizuku 授权后手机操控报「身份改变」；HyperOS / Android 16 一直 60 Hz（刷新率设置现在也作用到画面本身）；APK 已下好但空间只够一份时误报空间不足；同一路径的图片被覆盖后，旧消息里显示成新图；模型列表接口返回 404 时现在会提示可以手动添加模型；模型选择里过长的名字显示不全；伙伴自动想起记忆时误把子代理配置当成对话内容；桌宠、悬浮窗菜单、伙伴小组件和网页岛的几处显示问题。
- **验证情况。** 这一版的新功能大部分只经过自动测试和编译检查，tawcroot 默认启动、后台保护、远程备份和网页版都没有在各种真机上完整走过。iOS 安装包等 C

body:
# NipaPlay Next · Developer Preview

这是 NipaPlay Next 的第七个开发者预览（Alpha 7）。Next 重新组织了媒体库、播放器和个人助手之间的关系：你通过对话表达想做的事，梨花查询信息、选择工具并执行，结果呈现在书架、作品资料、播放器和弹幕里。

Alpha 7 修复 Alpha 6 中的几处严重问题：梨花的失败提醒在手机和平板上反复弹出、无法关闭；从 Codex 切换到 DeepSeek Harness 的对话在聊过一轮后无法再打开；只有一方能连到另一方的两台设备之间，下载等跟进结果送不回去。调用日志和组网记录不再无限增长。下面介绍本次更新与 Next 的主要能力。

本次预览由 **AimesSoft** 发布，面向开发者、Agent 系统爱好者，以及愿意一起探索这种使用方式的用户。

> [!CAUTION]
> **⚠️ 高风险实验性软件 · 仅供具备相关技术经验的用户测试**
>
> **NipaPlay Next 是具有完整用户级系统权限的 AI Agent 实验，而非面向普通用户的稳定版播放器。** 本次发布仅面向开发者、Agent 系统研究者及充分了解相关风险的技术爱好者。如果你不熟悉系统权限、Agent 行为及数据恢复，请继续使用 NipaPlay Classic。
>
> **Agent 具有广泛的系统操作能力。** 梨花可以在应用进程及当前用户拥有的权限范围内读写、覆盖和删除文件，运行程序、联网，并使用可访问的账号和登录状态。它的操作范围可以超出 NipaPlay 媒体库；不要将它视为只会回答问题的聊天窗口，也不要假定所有操作都会再次弹窗确认。
>
> **风险同样延伸到 Mesh 和内网设备。** 加入组网意味着信任同账号认证设备访问本机开放的能力和应用进程可访问的文件；启用远程程序运行后，其他设备上的 Agent 还可以在本机执行程序。处于同一局域网并不意味着安全，设备认证也不能防止已经受信任的 Agent 作出错误操作。
>
> **模型行为不可完全预测，错误操作可能造成不可逆的损失。** 模型误判、软件缺陷，以及网页、文件名、字幕等外部内容中的恶意指令，都可能引发数据丢失、隐私或凭据泄露、账号操作和额外费用。关闭 Next、切换回 Classic 或卸载应用，都不能自动撤销 Agent 已经执行的操作。
>
> **请仅在可承受损失的测试环境中使用。** 强烈建议使用隔离的测试设备、独立系统账号和可丢弃的数据副本，保留离线备份，只加入可信设备。**不要在存放唯一重要数据的主力电脑、工作设备或关键业务环境中直接试用。** 当前 Next 尚未提供完整的产品内备份与恢复能力。
>
> **注意模型服务的数据传输。** 模型服务会接收任务所需的对话与工具结果，其中可能包含文件内容、路径或其他敏感信息。请自行选择可信的服务商，了解其数据政策及可能产生的 API 费用。
>
> **如果你无法独立处理系统故障、检查 Agent 操作或恢复重要数据，请勿启用本次 Alpha 实验。**


## Alpha 7 更新了什么

### 提醒

- **一次失败只有一条提醒**：梨花运行失败时，由运行她的设备记一条提醒，正文是那次失败的原始错误。手机和平板显示的是那台设备上的同一条提醒，在任一端关闭，各端都不再显示。Alpha 6 中手机和平板上同一条报错反复弹出、关闭后立即重新出现的问题已修复。
- 提醒和错误面板显示具体的失败原因。

### 对话

- **切换运行器后的对话可以继续打开**：Alpha 6 从 Codex 切换到 DeepSeek Harness 后，对话在聊过一轮后无法再打开（报 `stored log is corrupt`）。新的交接不再出现这个问题；已经无法打开的对话，在第一次打开时自动修复，修复失败时保留原记录。

### 组网

- **单向可达时取回跟进结果**：例如一台在家庭内网、一台在公网，只有前者连得到后者时，下载等跟进结果由前者取回，不再一直重试。
- 跟进的目标设备被撤销、移出账号或 7 天未上线时，跟进标为失败并说明原因，可以手动重试。
- 手机和平板选择的梨花设备被撤销或移出账号后，选择自动清除。
- 组网的重放记录在异常退出后不再导致组网无法启动，长时间运行时不再持续增长。

### 存储

- 调用日志的归档只保留最近 4 卷，较早的自动删除。
- 下载器关闭期间，排队的下载任务不再反复写入记录；重新开启后立即继续。

## 我们希望探索什么

整理媒体往往是一连串具体判断：文件是哪一集、几个版本该选哪个、资料应该如何补齐、哪台设备能提供视频、怎样把片库摆成自己喜欢的样子。我们希望用户能够直接表达目标，让

name: Antigravity-Manager
body:
> Evolving from v5.0.3 to v5.0.4 through 20 preview releases, this version delivers a comprehensive refactor of streaming zero-tampering contracts, stealth sideloading and anti-degradation architectures, seamless official Hub & IDE parity, and a resilient scheduling/self-healing core:

-   **Streaming & Thinking Resilience**: Canonical `finishReason: "STOP"` and `[DONE]` frames for thought-only streams with zero content tampering, preserving real token usage; precise streaming truncation semantics preserving `MAX_TOKENS` and adding model-family boundaries for tier promotion; thinking cache corruption protection; Claude/Gemini thought folding and discriminated object union merging (Fixes #4008, #4006, #3997, PR #4007, #4005, #3878, #3866, #3867).
-   **WAF Evasion & Prompt Engineering**: Injected `[SYSTEM MANDATE]` authority anchor to completely eliminate model instruction decay, rule forgetting, and blind `ls -R` under stealth sideloading; neutralized upstream WAF pseudo-429 triggers across Pi agent codemode, WorkBuddy, Codex, and DSH; introduced fine-grained rule scope selectors (`all` / `prompt` / `tools`) (Ref #3997, Fixes #3981, #3982, #3983, PR #3986).
-   **Ecosystem Parity & Protocol Robustness**: Official Hub baseline upgraded to 2.33.0 (CL 1023160026) with local binary dynamic extraction; Antigravity IDE dual-write seamless hot-switch and onboarding terms suppression; Gemini 4+ dynamic codename extraction with Neon quota UI migration; enforced `type: array` on nested tool schemas (Fixes #3998, #4001, #3745, #3842).
-   **Scheduler Core & Quota Self-Healing**: CacheFirst sticky session deadlock prevention via auto-unbinding and pool failover; mutual exclusion between capacity exhaustion and budget degradation; cache-settling delay grace window maximizing long-context prefix reuse; per-model-family account priority scheduling and 403 authority convergence (Fixes #4002, #4000, #3991, #3863, #3875, PR #3879, #3881, #3882).
-   **Operations & Multi-Platform**: 4

name: EncoDeck
body:
### 改进

- 降噪档位、子模式（如 EarFun 的降噪子模式和手动档位）改为分段按钮：同一组选项放在一条底槽里，选中标记会滑到新选项（[#16](https://github.com/TIANLI0/EncoDeck/issues/16)）。
- 切换降噪模式、档位或子模式时立即显示新选择，并转圈直到耳机确认；耳机未采用时回到它实际所处的选项。
- 切换降噪模式时，下面的档位和子模式行立即换成新模式的（显示上次在该模式下的选择），出现和收起时平滑过渡，卡片高度不再跳动。

---

### Improved

- Noise levels and sub-modes (such as EarFun's noise cancelling sub-modes and manual levels) are now segmented buttons: the options share one track and the selection slides to the new one ([#16](https://github.com/TIANLI0/EncoDeck/issues/16)).
- Changing the noise mode, level or sub-mode shows the new choice at once, with a spinner until the earbuds confirm it; if they keep another setting, the selection returns to it.
- When the noise mode changes, the level and sub-mode rows below switch to the new mode's at once (showing the choice last used in it), and they appear and disappear smoothly instead of making the card jump.

name: Monica
body:
# Monica Android 1.0.330 · 千石抚子（SengokuNadeko）

紧急补丁 / Emergency hotfix

## 中文

对不起，这次是我的疏漏。327–329 版本中，部分用户把「自动锁定」设为「立即」后，即使输入正确密码也无法进入软件。密码管理器在需要使用时却打不开，给大家带来了不便，也让大家担心自己的数据。没能在发布前发现这个问题，是我的责任，向受影响的用户认真道歉，也感谢大家提供录屏和日志帮助定位。

1.0.330 是针对这个问题发布的紧急补丁，**「立即锁定」导致无法进入软件的问题已经修复**。

回溯时怀疑，这个回归可能与当时升级依赖有关，但具体引入点尚未完全确认。已经确认的直接原因是：同步和界面刷新中的会话检查，会把刚刚完成的认证再次撤销。这次已修复这两处误锁定，并保留重新进入应用、主动锁定和错误密码验证的保护。

已经遇到此问题的用户，请使用同一渠道、同一签名的 1.0.330 直接覆盖升级；不需要先回退到 326，也不要卸载或清除应用数据。本次补丁不修改密码算法、加密格式或数据库结构。已经验证旧版数据上的覆盖升级、原密码解锁、旧记录读取、新记录保存和加密备份恢复；用户的 HyperOS 真机仍需进一步反馈确认。

是因为我把代号写成千石抚子的原因吗？？？逆抚子来的。

## English

I am sorry. This was my oversight. In versions 327–329, some users who set Auto-lock to Immediately could no longer enter the app even with the correct password. A password manager being unavailable when you need it causes real inconvenience and worry about your data. I take responsibility for missing this before release, and I sincerely apologize to everyone affected. Thank you for the recordings and logs that helped identify it.

1.0.330 is an emergency hotfix. **The login failure caused by Immediately auto-lock has been fixed.**

Looking back, this regression may be related to the dependency upgrades at the time, but the exact change that introduced it has not yet been confirmed. The direct cause is confirmed: session checks during sync and UI updates could revoke authentication immediately after it succeeded. Both paths are fixed, while authentication on app re-entry, explicit locking and wrong-password rejection remain in place.

If you are affected, install 1.0.330 over your existing app using the same distribution channel and signing identity. You no longer need to roll back to 326 first. Please do not uninstall the app or clear its data. This patch does not change password algorithms, encryption formats or the database schema. name: clash-party
body:
# 2.0.5

## 新功能

- 简易模式合并到本地配置，支持直接以 Mihomo YAML 保存配置，并新增本地配置重新加载按钮
- 新增 MCP 服务，支持配置端口及访问令牌
- 订阅支持自定义主页，导入时自动填充订阅信息，并支持选择代理组
- 新增 Tailscale 节点认证通知，可点击通知打开认证链接
- 新增 InternetData 网络 IP 信息查询源
- 支持配置可信订阅的 YAML 别名解析上限
- 新增 Linux 便携 tarball 压缩包

## 优化

- 切换到本地配置时增加 DNS 覆写确认提示
- 订阅到期日期跟随系统区域格式显示
- 调整应用会话缓存位置，统一存放到缓存目录
- 点击标题栏时自动收起已打开的菜单

## 修复

- 修复本地配置未正确继承受控设置、受控设置优先级及出站模式保留问题
- 修复标准资源中代理集合缺失，以及更新代理集合后代理组未刷新的问题
- 修复关闭 use-hosts 后仍保留 hosts 覆写的问题
- 修复未加引号的 REALITY short-id 被错误解析为数字的问题
- 修复 macOS 启动时 DNS 保护未刷新，以及内核已有权限时重复授权失败的问题
- 修复 Windows 管理员重启时授权提示异常及取消授权后应用退出的问题
- 修复 Windows 管理员权限检测超时后错误缓存结果的问题
- 修复 Windows 内核清理可能影响其他程序或其他用户会话中内核进程的问题

# SillyTavern 1.19.1

A small patch release with security and robustness fixes. Updating is recommended for everyone.

## Fixes

* Fixed the handling of `<style>` blocks in chat messages and creator notes, which could let crafted content from a character card, an imported chat or a model response run scripts in the app.
* Fixed CharX and BYAF imports of characters with an unusable name placing asset files next to other character cards, where they could replace them.
* Fixed the user backup and delete endpoints accepting handles that are not existing users.

Security advisories with details will be published alongside this release. Thanks to the researchers who reported these issues.

name: FluentSetup
body:
### Added

- `files.variantSelection: "auto"`: setup chooses the variant from the PC. A variant other than the default is
  pre-selected when every requirement limited to it (`requirements.*.variants`) is already on the PC, otherwise the
  default; only variants the PC can run are offered, so the user sees a choice only when there is one. One package can
  install a framework-dependent build where .NET and the Windows App Runtime are present and the self-contained build
  elsewhere, without installing a runtime. Updates keep a variant the user picked while the PC can still run it and
  choose again otherwise; a repair keeps the installed variant; `/variant` still overrides it. New checks: FS1117 (value
  other than `user`/`auto`), FS1118 (fewer than two variants), FS1119 (a non-default variant with no requirement
  limited to it would always be chosen).
- Differential updates, opt-in (`update.differential: true`): the built-in updater keeps the downloaded Setup.exe on
  the user's PC (per user, the last one only) and rebuilds the next one from it, copying the streams it already has and
  fetching only the rest with HTTP range requests. The rebuilt file must match the published SHA-256 and signer like
  any download; without range support, or with little in common, the whole file is downloaded. The kept Setup.exe is
  also the repair source. Off by default: nothing is stored on the user's PC.
- `signing.files`: the app's own programs and DLLs are signed too (copies in the package, one signtool call for many
  files; already signed files are skipped). New checks FS1520, FS2005, FS2006.
- Branch filter for machine code (`output.codeFilter`, on by default): x86/x64 and Arm64 programs and DLLs are
  filtered before compression (relative call targets made absolute) and restored by setup. Native code comes out
  about 4–8 % smaller (MSVC's compiler binaries: 31.3 → 28.9 MB), .NET assemblies about 1 %, at the same build time.

name: ANR
body:
# ANR FG Beta, FG V.B20

## Changes

- Frame generation in HDR games with an FP16 scRGB backbuffer.
- Colours outside Rec. 709 (negative scRGB values) under the game's UI texture are interpolated like any other colour.

## Packages

- `anr-fg-V.B20-full.zip`: for games without OptiScaler.
- `anr-fg-V.B20-addon.zip`: for games that already use [OptiScaler](https://github.com/optiscaler/OptiScaler).
- `anr-fg-V.B20-full-optiscaler-source.zip`: OptiScaler's source (GPL-3.0).
- Test kits: V.B19's, unchanged (`anr-fg-V.B19-kit-windows.zip`, `anr-fg-V.B19-kit-linux.tar.gz` on the [V.B19 release](https://github.com/apex-compute/ANR/releases/tag/FG-V.B19); `TESTERS.md` inside). The macOS kit stays V.B15's.
- `nr-record-1.2-windows.zip`, `nr-record-1.2-linux.tar.gz`: [nr-record](https://github.com/apex-compute/ANR#record-and-compare-frame-generation) 1.2, the same as in V.B19 (checksums in `nr-record-1.2-SHA256SUMS.txt`).
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksums of the V.B20 files.

## Install

1. Close the game, extract the package and run the installer with the folder of the game's `.exe`:
   - Windows: `install.cmd` (needs the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable, x64)
   - Linux and Steam Deck (Proton): `sh install.sh "<folder>"`, then set the game's launch options to the line it prints (`WINEDLLOVERRIDES="dxgi=n,b" %command%`, or `winmm=n,b` in Vulkan games)
2. In the game, turn on frame generation (the NVIDIA option where the game offers several).

To uninstall, run `uninstall.cmd` or `sh uninstall.sh` with the same folder.

## Supported GPUs

NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 and newer, GTX 16; AMD Radeon RX 5000 and newer, Steam Deck; Intel Arc A and B. Windows 10 and 11, Linux and SteamOS with Proton.

## Feedback

Post performance results (the test kit's result file) and problems as [issues](https://github.com/apex-compute/ANR/issues/new/choose), with the newest `nr_fg-*.log` from the game's `OptiScaler/custom/Apex Neural Rendering FG` folder.

name: nocodb
body: ## What's Fixed - **Fields and formulas** - Changing a field type on PostgreSQL keeps every value that fits, renaming a field updates the formulas that use it, and a math error blanks only its own row. - **Filters** - *Is any of* matches the exact select option, empty filter groups are removed, and date filters work on lookups of date formulas and rollups. - **More filters** - Date filters with a wrong value are rejected on save, and filters on cross-base links apply for people who can see the linked table. - **Grid and records** - Escape cancels a cell edit, pasting a value that does not fit keeps the old one, and one edit makes one revision entry. - **Expanded records** - Ctrl/Cmd+F uses the browser's find while a record is expanded, and *Create & Link* from a new record creates the linked record when you save. - **Typing** - The first key typed with a Chinese or Japanese IME reaches the cell, and a barcode scanner in the link picker links the scanned record. - **Dates and numbers** - Dates before year 100 keep their year, Decimal fields from external databases use the column's scale, and Calendar weekdays follow the UI language. - **Rich text** - Rich text and code blocks keep their content and indentation after save and reload. hiddify-app
body:
# Highlights
- **A smarter Keep top.** Only the fastest proxies run and the others are parked. A kept proxy
  that stops answering is replaced, and the parked ones are checked again every hour. Client
  endpoints, WARP included, take part too.
- **21 new languages.** Nine more translations are now complete.
- **Lighter on CPU and battery.** Animations stop when nobody can see them. The connect button's
  light costs much less to draw. The core uses only as many processors as its load needs and
  paces the reads of busy connections.
- **OpenVPN profiles.** The app reads `.ovpn` files and `ovpn://` links.
- **Psiphon gets through more often.** As the first hop, Psiphon scans CDN edges with Chrome's
  TLS handshake and connects through the ones that answer. You can change its country from the
  home page.
- **WARP keeps searching, and can search deeper.** WARP searches for up to 3 minutes and learns
  which noise and tunnel work on each network. When a WARP or Psiphon search finds nothing, the
  app offers a deep search.
- **Proxies that are not secure are marked.** A proxy that anyone on the way can read gets a red
  *Not secure* mark that explains why. The list shows each proxy's transport and security, such
  as `VLESS · XHTTP · REALITY`.
- **Subscriptions download on hard networks.** The core downloads them with Chrome's TLS
  handshake. When a download fails, the app says why and what to try.
- **The desktop core runs in a process of its own.** The app's core is a library in the app, and
  only the proxies run in the engine. If the engine crashes, the app stays open, shows why it
  crashed and recovers.
- **VPN mode by default on desktop.** When VPN mode needs administrator permission, the app asks
  with a clear choice. On Linux it works without pkexec, and it also works in the AppImage.
- **Router mode on Linux.** A transparent proxy for a whole network.

body:
## 获取方式

### Docker（多架构 linux/amd64 / linux/arm64）

```bash
docker pull docker.io/bestzwei/libretv:2.24.0
docker pull ghcr.io/librespark/libretv:2.24.0
```

两个 registry 的镜像内容一致（同一组 digest），`latest` 也指向本版本。

### 免 Docker（下方附件，Node 18+）

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
tar -xzf libretv-2.24.0-standalone.tar.gz -C libretv
cd libretv && PASSWORD=your-password PORT=8080 node server.js
```

预构建包与 CPU 架构无关（x86_64 / arm64 / armv7），环境变量与 Docker 部署一致。

> 镜像由 docker-publish 工作流在同一 tag 上构建，刚发布时可能还要 5–10 分钟才可拉取。

## 如何使用

2. 双击对应的 `MAW` 可执行文件，打开启动器
3. 在启动器中，可以执行字幕转写、生成工程等操作
4. 完成后，启动字幕编辑器，进行字幕精修

详细文档参阅：[完整使用文档](https://github.com/Moyf/moys-asr-workflow/blob/main/docs/user/WORKFLOW.md)
遇到问题可以参见：[常见问题](https://github.com/Moyf/moys-asr-workflow/blob/main/docs/user/FAQ.md)

# 修复版本说明

## [1.11.4] - 2026-11-18

### 🐛 修复

- **字词时间码对齐** ： 修复完整版软件在使用本地对齐模型时可能找不到内置 FFmpeg 的问题。
- **缩略图缓存读取** ： 减少缓存写入期间读取已有画面时不必要的等待。
- **ASS 字体回退** ： 本机字体信息可用时，普通文字按完整字素簇选择缺字回退字体。
- **ASS 字体按需加载** ： 普通字幕启动不再扫描或下载字形覆盖表，仅在启用 ASS 或使用 ASS 输出时初始化。
- **文字处理输入焦点** ： 修复用户预设加载完成时，正在编辑的规则输入框可能失去焦点的问题。
- **字幕边界调整保存** ： 修复按住波形字幕边界调整时，自动保存可能意外改变相邻字幕结束时间的问题。
- **OTIO 媒体路径** ： 修复媒体或贴纸的本地路径包含特殊字符时，导出的 OTIO 可能无法正确定位文件的问题。
- **空副轨设置** ： 修复双语字幕副轨为空时仍显示字幕列表显示方式、自动适配高度和轨道徽标设置的问题。

# 大版本更新特性

## [1.11.0] - 2026-11-09

![1.11.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Moyf/moys-asr-workflow/v1.11.0/docs/assets/sticker/moy-idea.gif)

该版本集中提升了**自动化出片** 与 **操作体验改善** ： 波形字幕块支持原位气泡快速编辑，新增图片格式的字幕导出选项（FCP7XML），新增了 CLI 的烧录字幕参数、编辑器的文本处理多步骤与预设，并且字幕可绑定单句 ASS 样式。

其他零碎改动：AI 自动移除的区段可快速恢复，修复第三方字体显示、慢盘烧录中断排查、空隙播放音头修正，etc。

### 🚀 全新特性

#### 快速编辑弹窗
**波形区字幕快速编辑** ： 双击波形区的字幕块即可在小弹窗中快速编辑字幕文本——不用再跑去看字幕编辑区啦！

**打开方式**
- 双击字幕、选中字幕后按 Enter，或者右键编辑字幕

name: KumoApp
body:
Kumo 0.1.0 is a rewrite in Go, MyGo, and React. Profiles, overrides, settings, and state carry over from 0.0.x.

- Topology canvas, setup, About, agent prompts, and `kumo prompt`.
- A guardian stops the core and clears a system proxy Kumo still owns after a crash or force quit.
- Port conflicts name the holder and can move to a free port.
- JavaScript overrides (`main(config)`). Linux amd64 and arm64 builds.
- Another app's system proxy is left alone; Kumo can reclaim on request.
- TUN permission is a one-time grant. New and unset TUN settings use the MIPS stack, which needs Mihomo 1.19.32 or later. Stored stacks are kept.
- The profile import dialog keeps its footer inside the popup.
- Swift sources and bundled Sub-Store are gone.

Limitations:

- macOS builds are ad hoc signed only. Gatekeeper blocks them on other Macs. This release does not sign with a Developer ID or notarize.
- In-app updates are off. About shows that updates are not available, and there are no update files. 0.0.x reads `latest.yml`, which this release does not publish, so those installs move to 0.1.0 by hand.
- Windows is not released.

name: BewlyCat
body:
### 新增

- **功能模块开关**：支持在「设置 → 通用」按需独立开关 Bewly 页面、顶栏、Dock 栏、评论与播放器增强等模块
- **独立设置页与浮层**：新增独立扩展设置页（可从工具栏图标打开），保留站内设置浮层并支持新标签页打开
- **播放页毛玻璃与圆角**：新增视频与番剧播放页整页毛玻璃风格及播放器圆角开关
- **环境光泊松扩散**：视频环境光新增「泊松扩散」模式及相关参数调节
- **快捷过滤面板**：首页「个性推荐」与动态页标签栏新增过滤按钮，可直接调整过滤条件
- **动态热评定位与投票折叠**：支持点击动态热评展开评论区并定位，长投票选项默认折叠
- **播放器控制项**：新增方向键音量步进设置，画面旋转镜像与音画同步支持单独开关
- **本地壁纸备份**：设置导入导出支持一并备份与恢复本地上传的壁纸
- **接口错误详情**：请求失败时支持查看并复制脱敏错误报告，细化首页推荐失败原因提示

### 优化

- **设置分类与搜索**：重整设置菜单与分组顺序，搜索支持分词匹配并直接在内容区过滤结果
- **动态页加载性能**：动态列表启用滑动窗口按需挂载与回收，正在直播名单改为按需分页加载
- **首页滚动与回顶**：优化回到顶部缓动曲线，统一首页切换栏目时的滚动定位
- **收藏页交互**：视频卡片支持悬停预览，搜索框支持一键清空并消除切换批量操作时的跳位
- **稍后再看移除**：改为单击即删并保留还原撤销，支持手动收起已移除的占位卡片
- **宽屏与音量面板**：Bewly 宽屏窄侧栏移出后自动收起；播放器面板的音量均衡开关改为仅临时作用于当前页
- **图文卡片与多语言**：统一图文卡片样式与悬停效果，适配 B 站多语言页面视频标题翻译
- **界面快捷入口与选项**：补齐编辑模式入口，新增卡片右键「自定义菜单」及 Dock、抽屉与图片查看器细节开关

### 修复

- **音量均衡播放异常**：修复暂停恢复后可能出现 0.5 倍速变调的问题，并保证后台标签页正常出声
- **搜索框自动填充**：修复搜索框触发浏览器账号或密码自动填充弹窗的问题
- **滚动条占位与 Dock 高亮**：修复顶栏、Dock 与原版页面切换时的滚动条宽度偏移及 Dock 高亮不同步问题
- **视频环境光兼容**：修复在稍后再看列表页误开启及番剧海报页出现白色遮挡的问题
- **卡片预览与推荐反馈**：修复点击视频卡片后丢失悬停预览进度，以及 Web 推荐「不想看此 UP 主」上报有误的问题
- **播放器与宽屏细节**：修复评论深链进入视频页时宽屏滚回播放器，以及自动恢复倍速时弹出多余提示的问题
- **界面遮挡与交互细节**：修复顶栏弹窗意外收起、动态更多按钮被遮挡、评论吸底栏遮挡输入框及暗色专栏黑条等问题
- **数据同步与脚本更新**：修复云同步导致设置被反复写入，以及扩展更新后旧版页面脚本残留的问题

### 移除

- 移除播放器「听视频」功能
- 移除播放器「竖屏放大」功能
- 移除动态页「想看」分组功能（「固定 UP 主」保留）
- 移除视频卡片底部阴影自定义设置
- 移除未使用的 `hls.js` 依赖

name: AstrBot
body:
## [4.30.0-beta.1] - 2026-11-18

**本版本为 Beta 测试版，可能存在不稳定或兼容性问题，建议先在测试环境验证。本次涉及对话数据库、Agent 配置和会话设置迁移。升级前请备份数据与配置；回退旧版需同时恢复升级前备份。**

### 自 v4.30.0-alpha.1 以来的更新

- 用户追加指令（Steering）时，自动将等待中的工具调用移至后台任务，前台继续处理新输入。 (#11142)
- 修复 QQ 官方群聊流式回复被合并的问题。 (#11229)
- QQ 官方适配器支持获取私聊用户名字，群聊显示名称优先使用群内用户昵称。 (#11184)
- 插件 Views 能力升级：ChatUI 新增分页工作台与常驻插件视图，支持从「＋」打开视图、拖动调整宽度、全屏以及按会话恢复标签页和布局。 (#11218)
- 插件 Views 能力升级：插件可在聊天消息内展示交互式 HTML 组件，通过命令、消息处理器或模型工具创建，并处理用户操作；其他平台保留文本回退。 (#11179)
- 插件 Views 能力升级：插件视图统一在 `metadata.yaml` 的 `views` 中声明。 (#11218)
- ChatUI 支持语音转写为可编辑草稿；ChatUI 内模型配置页上方增加「对话 / 语音转文字 / 文字转语音」分类入口。 (#11170)
- 将聊天推理侧栏改为消息内可折叠的运行详情，分组展示思考、工具调用与中间回复；后端持续运行时，刷新或重连可恢复正在执行的对话并保留后续回复。 (#11166)
- 支持 Gemini 4 系列的推理强度配置，完善预览模型和请求参数兼容性。 (#11219)
- 减少上下文 Token 估算与截断的重复计算，合并会话元数据与幂等性查询，优化性能。 (#11167, #11199)
- 定时任务和后台任务唤醒时，仅通过显式消息工具发送通知，避免额外自动发送完成摘要。 (#11198)
- 保留 OpenRouter 非流式回复中的推理详情。 (#11168)
- 修复 Gemini 历史消息中的 URL 音频处理，并保留 SDK 3.4 下的自定义 User-Agent。 (#11143, #11196)
- DashScope TTS 支持 Qwen-Audio-TTS。 (#10495)
- System One 布尔判断支持可选的真假判定条件，修复部分兼容端点连接测试返回 HTTP 400 的问题。 (#11062)
- 修复切换聊天会话时欢迎页闪现的问题，并移除已弃用的 VoceChat 图标引用。 (#11182, #11186)
- 测试配置与本地 AstrBot 数据隔离，完善 Windows 数据库清理，并在项目交付测试中显式禁用 Git 签名。 (#11231, #11222)
- 更新插件开发文档中的 QQ 群信息。 (#11178)

### alpha.1 主要更新

- 将会话后端迁移到事件溯源方式，减少重复上下文写入和部分写放大，优化存储性能；增量保存消息与工具调用，完善执行中断后的历史处理。 (#10077, #11158, #11162)
- 引入新的 Agent 运行时模型。插件可通过 `ctx.agent.run_turn()` 唤起 Agent turn。 (#10934, #10936, #11052, #11148, #11153)
- 重构子代理为具有独立上下文的后台任务，支持通用与专用 Agent、追加指令和结果回传。入口由侧边栏移至 **配置文件 → AI → 能力 → 子代理**，按配置文件管理。 (#11053)
- 将自定义规则与会话管理统一至 **配置文件 → 管理会话配置映射**，支持基础配置与字段覆盖、批量编辑和恢复继承；模型指令与页面共用同一份设置。 (#11097)
- 新增 Windows AppContainer 本机沙盒，支持工作区隔离、代码执行与联网控制。 (#10466)
- 新增 DeepSeek 语音识别与语音合成提供商。 (#11118)
- 新增 OpenAI Decisions 判断模型，支持选择、布尔判断与评分。 (#10968)
- **欢迎页 → 总览**：展示每日用量、系统资源及机器人异常。 (#11100)
- 支持在外观设置中将聊天入口放入侧边栏。 (#11090)
- 升级 Markdown 渲染，按需加载聊天与语法高亮资源。 (#11138)
- 插件配置支持可折叠分组，并可声明默认收起状态。 (#11067)
- 插件页面可获取当前主题颜色及其变化。 (#11046)

## Release Notes for 32.7.4

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/draw.io-32.7.4-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/draw.io-32.7.4-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/draw.io-universal-32.7.4.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/drawio-amd64-32.7.4.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/drawio-x86_64-32.7.4.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/drawio-x86_64-32.7.4.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.11.3
- Fixes HTML export from the command line failing or hanging on very large diagrams
- Stops reading a diagram embedded in a PNG or PDF file once it is longer than the longest text the app can hold, instead of decompressing all of it first
- Command line PDF exports with --width or --height now contain the diagram, fitted to that size, instead of an empty page [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2162]
- Command line PDF and SVG exports fill in %pagecount% [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2601]
- Command line exports no longer wait forever for an image whose server never answers: an image that makes no progress for 15 seconds is left out and the export completes
- Links in exported SVG and PDF files keep only safe link types, and PDF exports no longer contain links to the install folder
- The Grid option of the advanced export dialog now works in the desktop app
- Removes data sources from the desktop app, where they could never load
- The public repository now carries the Linux source of each release; the Windows and macOS packaging files are no longer published there
- Updates to [draw.io core 32.7.4](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.7.4/ChangeLog). All changes from 32.6.10 to 32.7.4 are added in this build.

name: dsh-drawai
body:
整片风格参考帧：16 种风格共 149 个文件（126 张 jpg + 4 张 png + 每个风格的清单 + 上游许可与说明），约 40MB。

它们取自上游 [Vincentwei1021/mg-styles-15](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/mg-styles-15) 的成片截帧
（MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Vincentwei1021），只作视觉参考：按主题独立设计，不照搬画面或分镜。
画面里的第三方内容、字体可能另有许可；详见包内 `LICENSE-mg-styles-15.txt` 与 `README.md`。

插件第一次读参考帧（`mg_style {action:"frames"}`）时自动下载，逐文件校验后落到
`~/.dsh/drawai-style-reference-frames/collection-20261116/`，之后离线可用；
也可以先跑 `mg_style {action:"install"}` 预下载。参考帧是可选的，没有它也能按风格施工包做片子。

- 打包：`node tools/build-style-frames-pack.mjs`
- 发布：`node tools/publish-assets.mjs --frames`

name: iPhoneMirror
body:
这是 Windows x64 预览版，汇总 v1.8.5-pre5 之后的修复和新增功能。

### 投屏与视频应用播放

- 修复原始 AirPlay 视频应用投放中，短片、广告和正片交接时的完成通知、进度查询和跳转解析；自然结束保留发送端会话，避免接收端提前停止整个投放。关联 [#88](https://github.com/RayrenSX/iPhoneMirror/issues/88)。
- 改善分离音视频 HLS 的跨段时钟、分片失败重试、首帧等待和有限恢复；修复暂停、重播、Seek 与旧播放器回调之间的竞争。播放失败不会被误报成自然播完。
- 修复爱奇艺本集完成后不能接收下一集的问题。用户实测确认哔哩哔哩画面、声音和结束正常，以及爱奇艺本集完成后下一集能够打开；不同服务端、网络和机型仍可能有差异。
- 修复 UxPlay 横竖屏切换时的帧尺寸、旋转和 Y4M 输出处理，避免花屏或接收中断。关联 [#90](https://github.com/RayrenSX/iPhoneMirror/issues/90)。
- 修复无线预览会话重建后未重新绑定渲染目标导致的黑屏；用户使用 iPhone 17 在原画与 1080p 之间往返切换已通过。
- 应用设置增加显式代理选项，保存后供相关网络请求和子进程使用，并保持本机通信的正确路由。

### 反向控制、窗口与界面

- 改善主预览和独立窗口的输入接管、窗口关闭后的前景交接，以及 USB 连接恢复、外接键盘注册和启动取消处理。
- 有线／无线控制增加“手机输入法：显示／隐藏”按钮，默认显示。偏好应用到在线通道并在重连后恢复；有线和无线下的两轮切换与电脑输入均经用户实测确认。
- 修复关闭控制状态或设置窗口时主界面退到后台的问题；从独立投屏窗口发起控制时，将焦点交还正确的所属窗口。两种控制方式均经用户复测确认。
- 调整首次使用助手关闭按钮、步骤和驱动准备页对齐，优化驱动管理器卡片、设备选择与按钮布局，修复设备管理文件页的白色外框。
- 界面描述文字默认隐藏，修复部分说明未跟随设置即时隐藏的问题；优化禁用按钮底色，并移除不再使用的“清除所有蓝牙绑定数据”入口。
- 更新设备外观与机框资源，校准近期 iPhone 的圆角参数，并同步主预览、简易模式及独立窗口的裁切。部分素材拟合与保守轮廓不等于所有机型已经真机逐像素验证。

### 设备管理与文件

- 集成设备管理侧栏，提供应用查看、搜索和管理，以及文件浏览、导入、另存为和确认后删除。开发者工具保留设备信息、描述文件、日志等入口。
- 文件页支持媒体目录与支持文件共享的 App 文档目录，可用开关临时映射到 Windows 资源管理器；支持复制进出、创建文件夹、重命名和删除。
- 修复 Windows 复制文件时的属性设置步骤导致上传回滚的问题，保留文件修改时间；约 3.84 MB 中文 PPTX 的复制及打开已由用户实测确认。应用文档浏览和映射读写也已确认。
- 映射默认关闭，切换设备、断开控制或退出程序时清理。沿用 Windows WebClient 的单文件传输限制，界面会显示当前限额。
- 驱动管理器随完整交付提供；设备识别和布局已由用户复测确认。

### 验证范围与已知限制

- 发布流程运行原生、Python、应用逻辑、驱动和本地化检查，并生成安装包、便携包、独立 UxPlay 组件、SBOM 与 SHA-256 校验清单。
- 应用文档共享和媒体目录均不等同于手机“文件 → 我的 iPhone”的完整目录。仅电脑端的原生目录一致映射尚未实现，本版不宣称支持。
- #88 中接收端能力上限、实际帧尺寸与帧内内容比例是不同概念；正方形画布不自动代表视频被拉伸。原报告 iPad 的独立窗口场景仍欢迎按本版复测，不将其它机型的验证扩大为全部兼容性保证。
- 未将 BGMI 4K 麦克风场景、完整游戏映射或 macOS 支持列为本版已解决。
- 本版移除不可用的实验性 CoreDevice 原生媒体入口和录制文件重放入口；常规 USB／AirPlay 投屏及现有录像功能继续保留。

---

### Fixed

- Fix AirPlay video-item completion, ad/content handoff, scrub parsing, bounded HLS recovery and iQIYI next-episode notifications. Bilibili audio/video/completion and an iQIYI next-episode handoff were confirmed on a user phone. Related: #88.

* Finally work around that [stupid AMI NTFS driver bug](https://github.com/pbatard/AmiNtfsBug), so that runtime UEFI media validation can work on the millions of PCs that AMI screwed up
* Finally report USB 3.2+ devices (USB 3.2 = 20 Gbps, USB 4.0 = 40 Gpbs, USB 4.1 = 80 Gbps — See, USB Forum, it's really NOT that hard!)
* Fix the CA 2023 updated files not being taken into account during runtime UEFI media validation
* Fix the "Silent" installation option being potentially applied even when all dependencies aren't met (#3008)
* Fix a regression where "Write as ESP" used the whole drive, instead of the expected 1 GB partition
* Fix WUE timezone duplication for non English locales (#3070, #2499) and reinstate the use of dots in local usernames (#3057)
* Add classic right click context menu restoration to the QoL improvements option (courtesy of @Fredolx , #3007)
* Drop the ever problematic use of Group Policies when disabling the _"Do you want to format this drive?"_ prompt (#3042)
* Improve raw image partition (re)mount (courtesy of @jaredhagel2, #3002)
* Update embedded [GRUB](https://gitlab.com/gnu_grub/grub) to version 2.16
* Update [libcdio](https://github.com/libcdio/libcdio-C) to latest
* Update the official UEFI DBX URLs, since they were changed by Microsoft
* Address multiple vulnerabilities, courtesy of @indep-arg, @andife, Adam Korczynski, @SilentSobs and @kasparovabi: 
  - GHSA-hhx4-pjqh-499x, GHSA-hrxr-p5wv-qxm2, GHSA-6xgr-6q48-jwxr, GHSA-xh22-8phc-hw8j, GHSA-877g-r8h5-fq8p, GHSA-hcpc-vq8c-923h, GHSA-w4w7-p3x2-3p83, GHSA-j6fh-hww6-74mw, GHSA-xx6m-qq8h-8882
  - #3033, #3022
  - ANT-2026-QQV5VRY4, ANT-2026-A0JKMSB0, ANT-2026-85N3B2M9, ANT-2026-3CMBZ6X6, ANT-2026-1FCTXF5S, ANT-2026-0J6W5VHP
  - It should be noted that **all** the vulnerabilities above either require an already compromised system (for local to elevated exploitation), or a malicious ISO, or a MITM/domain/GitHub compromise, in which case you are most likely already p0wned,

name: dsh-vision-router
body:
# v3.4.0 — Optional local OCR engines / 按需安装本地 OCR 引擎

**Release identity / 发布状态：** This document describes the contents of v3.4.0, not proof that the version is already published. Publication requires an immutable GitHub tag/Release, npm `latest` and successful signed-package identity verification by the protected Release workflow. / 本文说明 3.4.0 更新内容；正式发布须以受保护工作流、不可变 GitHub tag/Release 和 npm `latest` 的包体核验结果为准。

## Overview / 主要变化

**Both local OCR engines are optional. No native OCR executable or model is installed during ordinary `dsh-vision-router` plugin installation.** Most users can continue to use the existing, authorized vision-model fallback for image transcription without installing either local engine. / 两个本地 OCR 引擎完全可选。用户正常安装 Vision Router 不会自动安装 OCR 程序或模型；多数用户无需配置，继续按既有策略回退视觉模型。

Open **DSH Settings → Vision Router → Local & device → Optional local OCR** (本地与设备 → 可选本地 OCR) to inspect and manage the two local engine choices:

### Tesseract / 系统优先，插件私有版可选

- If the machine already has usable system `tesseract` with **both** `chi_sim` and `eng` language data, **reuse it directly** and disable the redundant Install button. Never uninstall or modify the user's global Tesseract. / 系统已有可用的简体中文和英文 Tesseract 时直接复用，不重复下载、不改动系统安装。
- Otherwise an explicit **Install Tesseract** click can install a **private Tesseract.js 7.0.0/WASM** runtime and Chinese/English traineddata. It is not installed by npm during plugin installation and does not require a system-wide package manager operation. Pinned npm SHA-512 and language-data SHA-256 are checked, staged atomically, and removed only by the plugin-owned uninstall. / 未检测到完整系统版时，用户可以在设置里主动安装插件私有的 WASM 与中英文模型，或独立卸载。
- Managed recognition executes in a bounded Node subprocess with cancellation, resource limits and Electron Host compatibility. Installation and recognition can require temporary network access for the opt-in download, but later inference uses locally installed assets. / 安装时需联网，安装完成后的识别在本机进行；执行有超时、取消与资源限制。
- Nat

name: foo-webview-default-theme
body:
# 0.4.1

0.4.1 为高解析度无损曲目增加金色 Hi-Res 标识，支持在主视图与沉浸视图中分别配置歌词外观，为视频页补上快捷键与画面操作，并新增首次安装器。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **宿主组件要求**：本版本要求搭配 **foo_ui_webview2 2.2.0 或更高版本**，且必须以**独立窗口（Standalone Window）**模式运行（不支持嵌入 DUI 或 CUI 面板）。

---

### 资产下载说明

从下方 Release 资产列表下载时，请区分各文件用途：
- **普通用户推荐下载**：`foo-webview-default-theme-setup-0.4.1.exe`（首次安装器，推荐）；或 `foo-webview-default-theme-0.4.1.zip`（主题完整包，用于手动安装）。
- **更新器内部包**（无需手动下载）：`fe-0.4.1.zip`、`be-0.4.1.zip`、`release.json` 及 `changelog.json` 供主题内置在线更新器按需拉取。
- **源码包**：GitHub 自动生成的 `Source code` 仅包含开发源码，不可直接作为主题运行。

---

### 安装与升级指南

#### 1. 用安装器全新安装（推荐）
1. **运行安装器**：运行 `foo-webview-default-theme-setup-0.4.1.exe`，选择 foobar2000 所在的根目录。安装器将 foo_ui_webview2 2.2.0 组件与主题装入目标目录，不改动 foobar2000 的既有配置；若检测到同版本或更高版本组件则自动保留，已存在的主题目录保持原样。
2. **选择界面模块**：启动 foobar2000，在弹出的「发现新的用户界面模块」对话框中选择「Webview2 UI」。若未弹出该对话框，可前往 `File > Preferences > Display` 将用户界面模块切换为「Webview2 UI」。

> [!NOTE]
> **未签名安装提示**：由于安装包未签名，Windows SmartScreen 可能出现「Windows 已保护你的电脑」提示，发布者显示为「未知发布者」。点击「更多信息」后选择「仍要运行」即可。
> **运行环境要求**：需 64 位（x64）Windows 系统，foobar2000 2.0 或更高版本（兼容 32 位与 64 位架构）。系统需具备 WebView2 Runtime，缺少时安装器会提示并可打开下载页，安装照常继续。

#### 2. 全新手动安装
1. **安装宿主组件**：下载并安装 [foo_ui_webview2 2.2.0](https://github.com/NereaFantasia/foo_ui_webview2/releases/tag/v2.2.0)（或更高版本），按提示重启 foobar2000。确保系统已具备 WebView2 Runtime。
2. **解压主题文件**：下载完整主题包 `foo-webview-default-theme-0.4.1.zip`，解压至对应配置目录下的 `webview-ui` 文件夹中：
   - 便携版（Portable）：`<foobar2000安装目录>\profile\webview-ui\default-theme\`
   - 标准安装版（Standard）：`%APPDATA%\foobar2000-v2\webview-ui\default-theme\`
   > **注意**：解压后请确认 `index.html` 直接位于 `<模板名>\` 根目录下，避免产生多余的嵌套层级。
3. **启用主题**：打开 `File > Preferences > Display > WebView2 UI`，选中该文件夹对应的模板，应用设置并重启 foobar2000。

#### 3. 从旧版本升级 (0.4.0 / 0.3.0 / 0.2.0 / 0.1.0)
- **主题内在线更新**：
  1. 若当前组件低于 2.2.0，先在主题「设置 > 关于」的「组件更新」一行点击「重启安装」并确认。组件下载并校验后，foobar2000 会自动退出、替换组件并重新启动。
  2. foobar2000 重启完成后，再次进入「设置 > 关于」检查主题更新。主题下载完成后，重启 foobar2000 即可生效。
- **手动覆盖升级**：

name: OptiScaler
body:
# OptiScaler v0.9.5 ## One final (packed) release for the Maintenance branch 🏁 It's been a while since our last stable 0.9.4 release, so now comes a new packed one. For quite some time now, we've been maintaining two versions side by side: the master branch (now Opti v10) and the 0.9 branch. With Opti v10 now reaching a point where it's mature enough, it's time to put all our focus into it as maintaining two separate codebases has become more of a burden. While this release brings quite a few new features and loads of fixes since 0.9.4, including FFX 2.4 SDK support, it also marks the end of active development for the 0.9 branch. Going forward, 0.9 will be considered in **Maintenance Mode** and provided **as is**. With that in mind, bug reports for the 0.9 branch will generally no longer be addressed. All development efforts are now focused on polishing Opti v10 and getting it ready for its proper release _(with a looot of new features, available under the [Nightly tag](https://github.com/optiscaler/OptiScaler/releases/tag/nightly))_ Full changelog below. ### Fun stats - TOTAL 2 MILLION downloads 📈, ~13.000 stars ⭐, ~720 confirmed working games ✅, over 210 supported OptiPatcher games 🔨 _Always check the [**Wiki**](https://github.com/optiscaler/OptiScaler/wiki) for more information on compatibility, FG options etc!_ --- If you like the work being done, it's now possible to **support the project**! _Also linked in the Readme_ * [**BMAC**](https://buymeacoffee.com/nitec) ☕ * [**Github Sponsors**](https://github.com/sponsors/cdozdil?frequency=one-time) ♥️

name: NOIR
body:
# NOIR v0.4.4 — reports, ignore rules, faster scans

This release makes reports easier to reuse, adds first-class ignore rules, and cuts cold-scan time by roughly 3x on large devices. Windows users can now install and update NOIR with Scoop.

## Highlights

- **CSV export** — every scan now writes `report.csv`, one row per flagged app with permissions, endpoints, category, and vendor.
- **`noir report`** — regenerate Markdown, HTML, and CSV from an existing `report.json` without connecting a phone. Useful for sharing a report or re-rendering after upgrading.
- **`--ignore` rules** — keep known-safe packages and upload hosts out of scans and reports. Rules support comments, `package`/`pkg` and `host`/`domain` prefixes, and are saved to `ignore.txt` for reproducibility.
- **Faster cold scans** — the device-side scanner lists the `classes*.dex` entries that actually exist instead of probing `classes.dex` through `classes99.dex`. On a 502-package Android 16 device, a cold scan dropped from roughly 3 seconds to 1 second per APK, with identical endpoint results.
- **Scoop** — install and update on Windows:
  ```powershell
  scoop bucket add verlintas https://github.com/Verlintas/scoop-bucket
  scoop install noir
  ```
- **`noir devices --json`** — machine-readable device listing for scripts and CI.
- **Report metadata** — `report.json` now stores the device product, so re-rendered HTML keeps the full device identity.
- **Toolchain** — Gradle wrapper 9.9.1.

## Upgrade notes

1. Portable users: download the asset for your platform and replace the old directory.
2. Scoop users: `scoop update noir`.
3. New outputs are `report.csv` and, when `--ignore` is used, `ignore.txt`.
4. Verify `SHA256SUMS.txt` before running any downloaded build.

WinGet packaging is prepared but still waiting for Microsoft administrator validation; use the portable build or Scoop for now.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
Source: https://github.com/Verlintas/NO

name: cc-switch
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.33

本版本修复了从第三方供应商切回 Claude 官方后，已经开着的 Claude Code 会话仍把请求发给上一家、要重开会话才恢复的问题。套餐额度查询新增 **Ollama Cloud**；授权中心的 **Antigravity 账号切换**现在也支持 Windows。

另外修复了 Claude Code / Claude Desktop 的供应商选 Gemini Native 格式时获取模型列表总报「API Key 无效或无权限」；部分服务商获取模型列表被 Cloudflare 拦下；Antigravity Orchestrator 仍有部分请求显示未定价；WebDAV 同步在一些 NAS 上完全用不了；WebDAV / S3 上传失败只显示「请求构造失败」；查询 xAI 额度时遇到网络抖动就被要求重新登录；更新 Skill 中途失败把原来的 Skill 删掉等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.33-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.33-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### Ollama Cloud 套餐额度

地址是 `ollama.com` 的供应商现在可以查询 Token Plan 额度（需求见 [#9382](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9382)）：现行套餐显示本期套餐内额度的剩余比例和重置时间，旧版套餐显示 5 小时和每周两个窗口的剩余比例。单独购买的额度不显示；按量付费的账号没有套餐额度，会说明原因。本机运行的 Ollama（`localhost:11434`）没有套餐，不会被识别。

- 新添加或一键导入的 Ollama Cloud 供应商默认开启额度查询；已有的供应商在卡片上点「配置用量查询」，Token Plan 模板会自动选好，打开「启用用量查询」后保存即可。

### Windows 上切换 Antigravity 账号

授权中心的 Antigravity 账号切换以前只支持 macOS，现在 Windows 也能用：切换后 agy 读到的是新账号，Antigravity 官方卡可以绑定账号、查看所绑账号的额度，打开终端前也会提示将切换到哪个账号。Linux 暂不支持。

---

## 修复

- **从第三方供应商切回 Claude 官方后，已经开着的 Claude Code 会话仍把请求发给上一家，要重开会话才恢复**（[#9247](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9247)，见 [#7808](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7808)、[#3057](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/3057)）：运行中的 Claude Code 只会读入 `settings.json` 里新增和改动的环境变量，被删掉的仍留在会话里。现在切换时先把要删的地址、凭据和模型映射写成空值，开着的会话下一条请求就不再用上一家，约 10 秒后再从文件里删掉。会话启动时就定下的主模型（`ANTHROPIC_MODEL`）不会跟着变：如果上一家设了它，切回后在模型菜单里选一次 Default，或者新开会话。
- **Claude Code / Claude Desktop 的供应商选 Gemini Native 格式时，「获取模型列表」总是报「API Key 无效或无权限」**：现在按 Google 要求的方式传 Key。经路由的实际请求本来就正常，只有获取模型列表受影响。另外，Pi、Oh My Pi、Kimi Code 选 Google 接口的供应商，获取模型列表以前最多只列出 50 个，现在能列全。
- **获取模型列表时，部分放在 Cloudflare 后面的服务商直接拒绝，被误报为「API Key 无效或无权限」**（[#7429](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7429)，见 [#7427](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7427)）：请求现在默认带上 User-Agent；供应商或请求头

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
**A thread send now reaches a session that is not running, on this device or on another of your devices, and starts it.** It needs senpi 2026.11.15-2 or later (omo pins it), and device service 0.1.31 or later on both devices for a wake from another device. A reply to a sender on another device reads only that device's sessions instead of the whole account listing; a send to a live session that is paused or holds a Stop answers `queued` with `waiting_on: { kind: "hold", device }`; and `waiting_on.kind` in a `thread_send` result can be `approval`, `hold` or `wake`. ([#13599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13599))

### Changed

- `omo remote enable` now sets the device up in one command after `omo login`. It installs the OmO device service when none runs, registers this omo's agent dir with it, turns remote sessions on, and installs and starts the always-on session host unit. If you signed in before the device service was installed, it also links that sign-in to the service, so `omo login` then `omo remote enable` leaves the device connected. Running it again changes nothing that is already in place (#13594). ([#13602](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13602)) ([#13606](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13606))
- `omo remote status` also shows this device's own units as the service manager reports them: the session host unit (running, enabled, pinned host), the device service's unit, whether the cold-wake entry is in place, and the agent dir omo registers. With `--json` these are a `local` object beside the status fields (#13594). ([#13602](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13602)) ([#13606](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13606))
- Thread gateway: waking a session that is not running is on (#13037). It runs on senpi 2026.11.15-2 or later (omo now pins it), the release whose session release drops a woken session's retained record. A message from another of your devices w

name: March7thAssistant
body:
开拓者开拓者！还记得上次本姑娘带来的那些新玩意儿吗？嘿嘿，本来还想好好庆祝一下呢，结果……怎么刚出发就冒出来这么多捣乱的家伙啊！哼，看来本姑娘的冒险还远远没有结束！

先说说手机里的事吧！这次本姑娘把 **Shizuku 安装包**也准备好啦！还有那些让部分 Root 设备启动不了、游戏退出后小助手却傻乎乎地卡在原地、偶尔认不出手机菜单的问题，也都好好修理了一番。呼～没想到钻进手机里冒险，还真有不少学问呢！

至于**货币战争 S2「入画奇航」**嘛……听说小克拉拉在「机心巧匠」的弹窗里卡住了，怎么都没办法继续前进？咦？等等……原来是本姑娘漏掉了这个特殊机制！呜哇，对不起啦克拉拉！现在已经好好适配啦，新赛季里其他几个不听话的小问题也一起解决了！还有清体力的时候，明明点了「开始挑战」，却站在原地一动不动……喂喂！这可不是摸鱼的时候啊！

对啦！之前送给开拓者的**「桌面分身」**也有新进展哦！战斗检测的问题已经修好，连接失败时还能直接查看排查说明啦！就算遇到那个叫 RDP 516 的麻烦家伙，也能找到对应的解决步骤。嘿嘿，这次连迷路时的地图都准备好了！

好啦好啦，虽然这次没有上回那么多惊天动地的新功能，但让小助手变得更可靠，也是本姑娘很重要的任务嘛！

**毕竟，冒险可不只是出发时的热闹，还得平平安安地抵达终点才行呀！** 📸✨

- 安卓版内置 Shizuku 安装包
- 货币战争 S2 支持「机心巧匠改装」事件
- 修复货币战争 S2 若干问题
- 修复清体力点击「开始挑战」后偶尔未进入战斗的问题
- 修复触屏模式特定情况下无法识别手机菜单的问题
- 修复安卓版部分 Root 环境无法启动的问题
- 修复安卓版启动任务时，接管的游戏退出后流程卡住的问题
- 修复桌面分身中战斗检测未生效的问题 [#1359](https://github.com/moesnow/March7thAssistant/pull/1359) @cklsit
- 桌面分身连接失败时可打开排查说明，遇到 RDP 516 会定位到对应步骤
- 优化性能和稳定性并修复若干已知问题
- [欢迎关注我们的B站账号，获取最新动态和教程](https://space.bilibili.com/3706960664857075)<!-- m7a:hide -->

body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release fixes agent-mode startup and performance problems, tightens certificate and update verification, and corrects several Docker, Swarm, and backup behaviors. Agents now skip manager-only work, and updates are always verified.

### Agent mode

- Skip manager-only scheduled jobs in agent mode (#4779, @gongloo)
- Skip manager-only RBAC and OIDC backfills on agent startup (#4776, @gongloo)
- Avoid redundant SQLite prepared statement cache and read pool on agent (#4778, @gongloo)
- Strip CR and LF from agent tunnel values in logs (#4771, @kmendell)

### Security and updates

- Reject legacy edge SPIFFE client certificates (#4795, @kmendell)
- Remove the `newSelfUpdater` preview and always verify updates (#4773, @kmendell)
- Bump `kit.getarcane.app/acfs` to v0.10.3 (#4796, @kmendell)

### Docker and containers

- Time out Docker disk usage requests (#4774, @kmendell)
- Match digest-strategy containers to tag update records (#4772, @kmendell)
- Pass enabled features into Docker backend builds (#4793, @kmendell)

### Stacks and configuration

- Keep stack `.env` across git syncs and editor saves (#4783, @NullishUsername)
- Skip global env file writes when unchanged or read-only (#4794, @kmendell)

### Backups

- Copy Rustic CA bundle into the container before start (#4797, @kmendell)

### Build

- Exclude the embedded Scalar bundle when building without the frontend (#4777, @gongloo)

**本版本为 Alpha 测试版，可能存在不稳定或兼容性问题，建议先在测试环境验证。本次涉及对话数据库、Agent 配置和会话设置迁移。升级前请备份数据与配置；回退旧版需同时恢复升级前备份。请不要在重要的生产环境使用该版本。**

### 主要更新

- 将会话后端迁移到事件溯源方式，减少重复上下文写入和部分写放大，优化存储性能；增量保存消息与工具调用，完善执行中断后的历史处理。 (#10077, #11158, #11162)
- 引入新的 Agent 运行时模型。插件可通过 `ctx.agent.run_turn()` 唤起 Agent turn。详见 [调用现有会话的 Agent](https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/blob/739840886c5fbbd439f477ac4b6e8eb7ba3e0649/docs/zh/dev/star/guides/ai/agent.md#%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%E7%8E%B0%E6%9C%89%E4%BC%9A%E8%AF%9D%E7%9A%84-agent-run-session-agent) (#10934, #10936, #11052, #11148, #11153)

- 将自定义规则与会话管理统一至 **配置文件 → 管理会话配置映射**，支持基础配置与字段覆盖、批量编辑和恢复继承；模型指令与页面共用同一份设置。 (#11097)
- 新增 Windows AppContainer 本机沙盒，支持工作区隔离、代码执行与联网控制。 (#10466)
- 新增 DeepSeek 语音识别与语音合成提供商。 (#11118)
- 新增 OpenAI Decisions 判断模型，支持选择、布尔判断与评分。 (#10968)
- **欢迎页 → 总览**：展示每日用量、系统资源及机器人异常。 (#11100)
- 支持在外观设置中将聊天入口放入侧边栏。 (#11090)
- 升级 Markdown 渲染，按需加载聊天与语法高亮资源。 (#11138)
- 插件配置支持可折叠分组，并可声明默认收起状态。 (#11067)
- 插件页面可获取当前主题颜色及其变化。 (#11046)
- 重整 AI 开发文档，补充插件配置控件示例与截图。 (#11154)

### 优化与修复

- 完善运行中追加输入的保存与继续执行。 (#11141)
- 跳过运行时不可用的子代理配置，避免阻断主会话。 (#11128)
- 允许取消选择已禁用、缺失或运行时不可用的子代理配置。 (#11147)
- 移除完整工具 Schema 模式下的默认工具调用提示词。 (#11152)
- 修复模型最后一次重试成功仍被判定为失败的问题。 (#10922)
- 修复 Anthropic 非流式响应丢失多个文本块的问题。 (#11057)
- 搜索密钥失效或额度不足时，尝试其他已配置的密钥。 (#10877)
- 将 Gemini TTS 默认模型更新为 `gemini-3.8-flash-tts`。 (#10828)
- 修复 QQ 按钮回复丢失图片、文件等媒体的问题。 (#10903)
- 避免 QQ 图片上传失败时记录完整图片载荷，减少日志对面板的影响。 (#10740)
- 优化 OneBot 流式分段，减少长文本的重复扫描。 (#10989)
- Telegram 发送者没有用户名时，使用显示名称。 (#10715)
- 修复 Firefox 中聊天历史滚动跳动的问题。 (#11036)
- 修复编辑模型配置时预览与能力标识不一致的问题。 (#10792)
- 统一 WebUI 菜单、弹窗样式，优化滚动条和点击反馈。 (#11107, #11090, #11102)
- 修复 EPUB 解析丢失链接文字的问题。 (#10794)
